messages.subject: Connecting a Shiny app  (Shiny IO) to a MySQL database in Ubuntu
parts: I am in need of some help with learning how to connect a MySQL database in Ubuntu to a Shiny app using the Shiny IO. What is the best way to connect? Thank you!

messages.author: 7c7cc1d5f087dffe
messages.subject: Re: Connecting a Shiny app  (Shiny IO) to a MySQL database in Ubuntu
parts:
Using DBI and RMySQL your naked connection string would look like this :
    mydbremote = dbConnect(MySQL(), user='user', password='password', dbname='databasename', host='211.222.233.244 or hostname',port=portnumber)
however for obvious reasons you won't want to leave it as a naked connection string anywhere insecure. i have a  file i keep in a secondary directory that has my connection string in a function which i include in app.r and i use a reactive value instead of using mydbremote.
